transferFactors.source: 0.181 as published in Andrews et al. 2003, Br J Psychiatry 183:427-435 ('Cost-effectiveness of current and optimal treatment for schizophrenia') and applied by WHO-CHOICE: Chisholm et al. 2008, Bull WHO 86:542, Table 2 ('Conversion = ES * 0.181'). Sanderson et al. 2004, Qual Life Res 13:1255 documents the GP-vignette method; its 0.204 (rating-scale) / 0.158 (TTO) are METHOD-SPECIFIC RANGE TOPS across five disorders, retained as sensitivity bounds; they are not verifiably schizophrenia-specific and no published source derives 0.181 as their mean.

transferFactors.notes: Fallback only, for conditions without a condition-specific mapping study.
